This '''yacht''' belonged to [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron 32" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Pestage used it to flee [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] accused him of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. After rendezvousing with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]] for passage to [[Ciutric IV]], Pestage gave the yacht to its [[Unidentified captain (Sate Pestage's private yacht)|captain]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron 32" />
